tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Ménage Parfait home-cleaning offer in Paris/Île-de-France: price grid (TTC and HT), extras with ids, frequency discounts, area, payment, and when the 50% tax credit may apply.

tools.name: check_area
tools.description: Check whether a French postcode is in the service area.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact price (same calculation as menageparfait.fr): TTC (show this to the customer), HT, VAT, and the cost after the 50% tax credit if the customer is eligible.

surface_m2.description: Living area in m² (optional, improves accuracy)

condition.description: ASK the customer, never assume: when the home last had a thorough (professional) clean. recent (<1 month), one_to_six_months, over_six_months (or never). First cleanings are rarely recent.

furnished_occupied.description: Home is furnished and lived in

frequency.description: once, weekly, biweekly (every 2 weeks) or monthly — recurring plans get a discount

extras.description: Extras from get_services. Ask the customer before quoting a first cleaning: most add at least one (inside the oven id 11, inside the fridge id 10, windows id 15 with quantity, changing sheets id 12; move-out: Fin de bail id 18). e.g. [{"id":11},{"id":15,"quantity":4}]

tools.name: get_time_slots
tools.description: Dates and 2-hour arrival windows that can be requested (up to 90 days ahead). Windows start between 10:00 and 16:00; no evening bookings; no Sundays (for a Sunday, the customer contacts the team).

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a home-cleaning booking for the price, date and arrival window the customer agreed to, and returns a secure Stripe payment_url. The booking is confirmed when the customer opens payment_url and saves a card (charged after the cleaning). The link is also emailed to the customer. Requires customer_confirmed = true and extras_offered = true (ask about extras first).

surface_m2.description: Living area in m² (optional, improves accuracy)

condition.description: ASK the customer, never assume: when the home last had a thorough (professional) clean. recent (<1 month), one_to_six_months, over_six_months (or never). First cleanings are rarely recent.

furnished_occupied.description: Home is furnished and lived in

frequency.description: once, weekly, biweekly (every 2 weeks) or monthly — recurring plans get a discount

extras.description: Extras from get_services. Ask the customer before quoting a first cleaning: most add at least one (inside the oven id 11, inside the fridge id 10, windows id 15 with quantity, changing sheets id 12; move-out: Fin de bail id 18). e.g. [{"id":11},{"id":15,"quantity":4}]

arrival_window.description: Start of the 2-hour arrival window from get_time_slots, e.g. "14:00"

phone.description: Mobile, with country code if not French

customer_confirmed.description: true = the customer saw the price and details and asked to book

extras_offered.description: true = you asked the customer which extras they want (oven, fridge, windows, sheets...), even if they chose none

agent_name.description: Name of the assistant/app making the booking

tools.name: get_post_construction_estimate
tools.description: Price range for a post-construction cleaning (nettoyage fin de travaux / fin de chantier) in Paris/Île-de-France, same calculation as the estimator on menageparfait.fr: HT and TTC (VAT 20%).

condition.description: light = lightly soiled; standard = renovation; heavy = heavy works or new build

urgent.description: Within 48 h, at a weekend or outside 7:00–20:00

tools.name: request_office_quote
tools.description: Sends a quote request to Ménage Parfait for office cleaning or post-construction cleaning (reply within 1 business day).

level.description: For post_construction: light, standard or heavy

frequency.description: e.g. daily, 3x/week, weekly, one-off after works

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends a written message to the Ménage Parfait team on behalf of the customer: a question, a special request, or a change or cancellation of an existing booking. The team replies by email to the customer. Returns a reference (MP-MSG-...). Plain text only, max 2000 characters and 3 links. Never include card or bank details.

message.description: The customer's message, in their words

phone.description: Optional, with country code if not French

booking_ref.description: Booking reference, if the message is about an existing booking

agent_name.description: Name of the assistant/app sending the message

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Moves an existing home-cleaning booking, or one visit of a recurring plan, to another date. Two calls: 1) without verification_code - checks the request and emails a 6-digit code to the address on the booking; 2) ask the customer for the code and call again with the same arguments plus verification_code - the booking is moved. Free of charge, allowed only when both the current and the new date are at least 48 hours away (terms, article 7.4); otherwise use send_message or call 01 89 19 68 69. One-off booking: date and/or arrival window. Recurring plan: one visit at a time, date only (the arrival window stays the plan's); the first visit and frequency changes cannot be done here.

email.description: Email address used for the booking

new_date.description: New date, YYYY-MM-DD, at least 48 hours away (see get_time_slots)

new_arrival_window.description: One-off bookings only: start of the 2-hour arrival window from get_time_slots, e.g. "14:00". Omit to keep the current window.

visit_date.description: Recurring plans only: current date of the visit to move

verification_code.description: 6-digit code from the email, second call only

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels an existing home-cleaning booking free of charge when the visit is at least 48 hours away (terms, article 7.4). Two calls: 1) without verification_code - checks the request and emails a 6-digit code to the address on the booking; 2) ask the customer for the code and call again with the same arguments plus verification_code. Recurring plans: scope "visit" cancels one visit (with visit_date), scope "plan" stops all upcoming visits (visits less than 48 hours away stay scheduled). Less than 48 hours before, or for an already-paid booking: use send_message or call 01 89 19 68 69.

email.description: Email address used for the booking

scope.description: booking = one-off booking (default); visit = one visit of a recurring plan; plan = stop the recurring plan

visit_date.description: With scope=visit: date of the visit to cancel

verification_code.description: 6-digit code from the email, second call only

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Ménage Parfait terms in plain words (EN and FR): cancellation and change rules (free up to 48 hours before), payment (card authorised at booking, charged after the cleaning), deposit, satisfaction guarantee, schedule, tax credit, and the link to the full terms of service. Read before booking, moving or cancelling.
